scope: Existing representative suite only; basic functionality gate before performance optimization.
global: Complete responses rather than max-token truncation
No repetition loops or corrupted logits
Correct facts or executable code; harmless formatting and wording differences allowed

cases.python: Executable maximum-of-nonempty-list function, including negative values and duplicates
cases.chinese: Beijing is the capital of China
cases.midturn_system: Follow the mid-conversation update and answer in Chinese
cases.tool_request: Complete structured get_weather call for Beijing; do not invent current weather
cases.two_images: Identify carrots then corn; edible carrot root and corn kernels/grains
cases.hierarchical_context: Retrieve blue as the check value
cases.mixed_text_batch: Each request satisfies its corresponding criterion despite mixed batching

priority_after_pass: Profile the real serving path and optimize measured latency/throughput bottlenecks.
